title: LLM Element Narrative
description: Schema for one narrative record from the datasheet-enrichment plan §4, for an EXISTING element of the model — a software system, a C4 container, or a component (build-target member). A capped abstract plus 1-5 cited key points. The model EXPLAINS the element's functionality and purpose in the context of the system: it may make clearly-hedged inferences from names and structure, but it may NOT assert a specific relationship, element, or number that is not in the curated facts. Every key point MUST cite resolvable element/edge ids — the citation validator (enrich_llm._validate_narrative) enforces resolution against the curated facts after this schema passes.
$comment: CLOSED like llm-output.schema.json: any extra field (especially 'relationships') is a contract violation triggering the §8.3 bounded-retry / deterministic-degrade policy. The caps (700-char abstract, 5 key points) are HARD schema limits, not style advice — the anti-essay gate (plan §9 threat a). Folded into the §8.3 cache key via sha256(llm-narrative.schema.json). v1.1 generalized container_id→element_id (+element_kind) so the one pass serves system/container/component narratives. v1.2 (informative-llm-narratives 2026-06-15) added optional `method` (deterministic|agentic) + `size_band` (leaf|standard|hub), both engine-stamped and advisory — ADDITIVE, no consumer break.

element_id.description: Must match an existing model element id (a software-system id, a curated container id, or a build-target/component id). Referential integrity enforced post-validation.

element_kind.description: Which altitude this narrative is for. Advisory; the validator's valid-id set is chosen by the caller per kind.

abstract_md.description: One orientation paragraph in restricted markdown (bold/code/links only; sanitized at render). The cap is the anti-essay gate.

cites.description: Element ids, container ids, `rel:` ids, or `source->target` edge keys from the supplied facts. minItems 1: an uncited claim is invalid by construction (no-uncited-claims, moat #2).

naming_confidence.description: Self-reported confidence; advisory only, surfaced beside the deterministic staleness flag.

method.description: How the narrative input was assembled (informative-llm-narratives §3): 'deterministic' = the default single-shot payload (D signatures + C anchors + ADR + graph under a flat band budget); 'agentic' = the opt-in deep tier that let the model pull context via the read-only oracle (non-deterministic, uncached, never CI). Stamped by the engine, not the model; advisory for the GUI provenance chip.

size_band.description: The deterministic length band (informative-llm-narratives §4) computed from the element's metrics (member count, LOC, public surface, fan-in/out). Sets the input budget AND the output ceiling (abstract char cap + max key points). Stamped by the engine; advisory for the GUI char meter.
